title: F. Berland and the Shortest Paths

legend: There are n$$$n$$$ cities in Berland. Some pairs of cities are connected by roads. All roads are bidirectional. Each road connects two different cities. There is at most one road between a pair of cities. The cities are numbered from 1$$$1$$$ to n$$$n$$$.
It is known that, from the capital (the city with the number 1$$$1$$$), you can reach any other city by moving along the roads.
The President of Berland plans to improve the country's road network. The budget is enough to repair exactly n−1$$$n-1$$$ roads. The President plans to choose a set of n−1$$$n-1$$$ roads such that:
it is possible to travel from the capital to any other city along the n−1$$$n-1$$$ chosen roads,

if di$$$d_i$$$ is the number of roads needed to travel from the capital to city i$$$i$$$, moving only along the n−1$$$n-1$$$ chosen roads, then d1+d2+⋯+dn$$$d_1 + d_2 + \dots + d_n$$$ is minimized (i.e. as minimal as possible).

In other words, the set of n−1$$$n-1$$$ roads should preserve the connectivity of the country, and the sum of distances from city 1$$$1$$$ to all cities should be minimized (where you can only use the n−1$$$n-1$$$ chosen roads).
The president instructed the ministry to prepare k$$$k$$$ possible options to choose n−1$$$n-1$$$ roads so that both conditions above are met.
Write a program that will find k$$$k$$$ possible ways to choose roads for repair. If there are fewer than k$$$k$$$ ways, then the program should output all possible valid ways to choose roads.
input: The first line of the input contains integers n$$$n$$$, m$$$m$$$ and k$$$k$$$ (2≤n≤2⋅105,n−1≤m≤2⋅105,1≤k≤2⋅105$$$2 \le n \le 2\cdot10^5, n-1 \le m \le 2\cdot10^5, 1 \le k \le 2\cdot10^5$$$), where n$$$n$$$ is the number of cities in the country, m$$$m$$$ is the number of roads and k$$$k$$$ is the number of options to choose a set of roads for repair. It is guaranteed that m⋅k≤106$$$m \cdot k \le 10^6$$$.

The following m$$$m$$$ lines describe the roads, one road per line. Each line contains two integers ai$$$a_i$$$, bi$$$b_i$$$ (1≤ai,bi≤n$$$1 \le a_i, b_i \le n$$$, ai≠bi$$$a_i \ne b_i$$$) — the numbers of the cities that the i$$$i$$$-th road connects. There is at most one road between a pair of cities. The given set of roads is such that you can reach any city from the capital.
output: Print t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤k$$$1 \le t \le k$$$) — the number of ways to choose a set of roads for repair. Recall that you need to find k$$$k$$$ different options; if there are fewer than k$$$k$$$ of them, then you need to find all possible different valid options.

In the following t$$$t$$$ lines, print the options, one per line. Print an option as a string of m$$$m$$$ characters where the j$$$j$$$-th character is equal to '1' if the j$$$j$$$-th road is included in the option, and is equal to '0' if the road is not included. The roads should be numbered according to their order in the input. The options can be printed in any order. All the t$$$t$$$ lines should be different.
Since it is guaranteed that m⋅k≤106$$$m \cdot k \le 10^6$$$, the total length of all the t$$$t$$$ lines will not exceed 106$$$10^6$$$.
If there are several answers, output any of them.

legend.ai: Berland 有 n$$$n$$$ 座城市。一些城市对之间由道路连接。所有道路都是双向的。每条道路连接两座不同的城市。任意一对城市之间至多有一条道路。城市编号从 1$$$1$$$ 到 n$$$n$$$。
已知从首都(编号为 1$$$1$$$ 的城市)出发，可以沿着道路到达任何其他城市。
Berland 总统计划改善该国的道路网络。预算恰好足够维修 n−1$$$n-1$$$ 条道路。总统计划选择一个包含 n−1$$$n-1$$$ 条道路的集合，使得：
可以沿着所选的 n−1$$$n-1$$$ 条道路从首都到达任意其他城市。
如果 di$$$d_i$$$ 表示仅沿着所选的 n−1$$$n-1$$$ 条道路从首都到城市 i$$$i$$$ 所需经过的道路数量，那么 d1+d2+⋯+dn$$$d_1 + d_2 + \dots + d_n$$$ 最小(即尽可能小)。
换句话说，这 n−1$$$n-1$$$ 条道路应当保持国家的连通性，并且从城市 1$$$1$$$ 到所有城市的距离之和应当最小(其中只能使用所选的 n−1$$$n-1$$$ 条道路)。
总统要求该部门准备 k$$$k$$$ 种选择 n−1$$$n-1$$$ 条道路的方案，使得上述两个条件均得到满足。
请编写一个程序，找出 k$$$k$$$ 种可供维修的道路选择方案。如果这样的方案少于 k$$$k$$$ 种，则程序应输出所有有效的道路选择方案。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含整数 n$$$n$$$、m$$$m$$$ 和 k$$$k$$$(2≤n≤2⋅105，n−1≤m≤2⋅105，1≤k≤2⋅105$$$2 \le n \le 2\cdot10^5, n-1 \le m \le 2\cdot10^5, 1 \le k \le 2\cdot10^5$$$)，其中 n$$$n$$$ 表示国家中的城市数量，m$$$m$$$ 表示道路数量，k$$$k$$$ 表示选择一组道路进行维修的方案数量。保证 m⋅k≤106$$$m \cdot k \le 10^6$$$。
接下来的 m$$$m$$$ 行描述这些道路，每行一条道路。每行包含两个整数 ai$$$a_i$$$、bi$$$b_i$$$(1≤ai,bi≤n$$$1 \le a_i, b_i \le n$$$，ai≠bi$$$a_i \ne b_i$$$)，表示第 i$$$i$$$ 条道路连接的城市编号。任意一对城市之间至多有一条道路。给定的道路集合保证可以从首都到达任意城市。

output.ai: 输出 t$$$t$$$(1≤t≤k$$$1 \le t \le k$$$)，表示选择一组道路进行维修的方案数。回忆一下，你需要找出 k$$$k$$$ 个不同的方案；如果这样的方案少于 k$$$k$$$ 个，则需要找出所有可能的不同合法方案。
接下来的 t$$$t$$$ 行中，每行输出一个方案。一个方案表示为一个长度为 m$$$m$$$ 的字符串，其中第 j$$$j$$$ 个字符如果为 '1'，则表示第 j$$$j$$$ 条道路包含在该方案中；如果该道路不在方案中，则该字符为 '0'。道路编号按照输入中的顺序确定。方案可以按任意顺序输出。所有 t$$$t$$$ 行必须互不相同。
由于保证 m⋅k≤106$$$m \cdot k \le 10^6$$$，因此所有 t$$$t$$$ 行的总长度不会超过 106$$$10^6$$$。
如果有多个答案，输出其中任意一个即可。
